document_type.instance: Character concept/model sheet with five views; not a game scene or finished sprite sheet.

style.lineart: Bold, clean 1–2 px black-like outlines; use Dr. Social's approved deep navy #000055 as the outline color for this SMS project.
style.morphology: 1990s shonen anime proportions and a distinct silhouette, adapted to Dr. Social's established tall, lean, long-limbed build; no chibi or broad/muscular redesign.
style.shading: Crisp, hard-edged three-tone cel shading per material; saturated color roles; no dithering, grain, blur, gradient, or painterly texture.
style.selected_biotype: Tall, slim ectomorph; lean adult with long limbs and narrow-to-average shoulders.

layout.background: Clean light gray, cream, or white; no scenery, texture, vignette, or distracting effects.
layout.alignment: Horizontal lineup; front, side, and back views share one scale and baseline. Keep all five views at a consistent character scale, with a relative ruler beside the orthographic views.

relative_ruler.definition: One H equals the character's head height from crown to chin.
relative_ruler.working_target: Approximately 7.5H tall for this sheet; visual guide only, not a canonical absolute height.
relative_ruler.baseline: Common ground baseline for front, side, and back views.

views: Full-body signature pose with rapier and occult boomerang

character_invariants: Dr. Ferdinand Social from Master of Darkness; human Victorian psychologist and vampire hunter, early thirties.
Lean, upright, composed, courageous, and justice-driven; remains fully human with no fangs, wings, claws, or transformation.
Gray swept-back hair; clearly visible round brass-rimmed spectacles; consistent face across all views.
Blue/cyan long coat or suit with teal shadows, white shirt, burgundy cravat, dark brown boots, brass details.
Keep the established cane, rapier, and occult steel boomerang. Violet is restricted to a restrained boomerang effect.
Do not add logos, crests, unexplained symbols, extra weapons, or costume details absent from the approved design.
